dct_description_sm: Surveyed and published for the Trust Company of Cuba, Insurance Department. Other places as they appear on original: Includes sugar warehouses in towns of: Antilla, Boqueron, Caibarien, Cimanera, Calecito, Cardenas, Castillo de Jagua, Cienfuegos, Guantanamo, Havana, Isabela de Sagua, Jamaica, Matanzas, Nuevitas, Pastelillo, Puerto Tarafa, Punta de Lara, Punta Deseo, Regla, Sagua la Grande, and Santiago.
